## How to contribute to SuiteCRM

Thank you for wanting to contribute. Please read the sections below before you start.

### Code of Conduct

This project and all community members are expected to uphold the [SuiteCRM Code of Conduct](https://github.com/SuiteCRM/SuiteCRM/blob/hotfix/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

### Need help?

For support questions and issues specific to your own setup, please use the [Community Forum](https://community.suitecrm.com/). See [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md) for more.

### Found a security vulnerability?

**Please do not open a GitHub issue, pull request or forum post.** See our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md).

### Found a bug?

* **Search the [open and closed issues](https://github.com/SuiteCRM/SuiteCRM/issues)** to check it has not already been reported.
* Check that the bug is still present in the latest release of SuiteCRM 7.
* If you cannot find it, [open a new issue](https://github.com/SuiteCRM/SuiteCRM/issues/new/choose) and complete the form.
* If an issue already exists and affects you, add a 👍 reaction to the first post. Voting helps us decide what to work on. [How voting works](https://docs.suitecrm.com/community/raising-issues/issues-voting/).

### Did you fix a bug?

Please read our guide on [How to submit Bug Fixes](https://docs.suitecrm.com/community/contributing-code/bugs/).

### Do you have an idea for a feature?

* If you would like to suggest a feature that you will not build yourself, please use the [Suggestion Box](https://community.suitecrm.com/c/suggestion-box/13) on the forum.
* If you want to build it yourself, please open a [Feature Proposal](https://github.com/SuiteCRM/SuiteCRM/issues/new/choose) and wait for a reply from the team **before you start**. A solution may work and still not be the direction of the product.
* Then read our guide on [How to provide a new Feature](https://docs.suitecrm.com/community/contributing-code/features/). Features are built as one pull request of atomic commits, which start with `[Feat #1234]`.

### Contributor License Agreement

You will be asked to sign our [Contributor License Agreement](https://cla.suitecrm.com/SuiteCRM/SuiteCRM) when you open your first pull request. We cannot merge code without it.

Thanks!

SuiteCRM Team
